Sub-field-address struct field-pun — `(CQuaternion4f *)&local_2d8.z` takes the address of a field at offset 12 inside `local_2d8` (a 16-byte CQuaternion4f), then casts it to CQuaternion4f * (same type as the local). A 16-byte access from that offset has only 4 bytes left and overruns `local_2d8` by 12 bytes (ASan stack-buffer-overflow; §26). Ghidra emits this when its stack-local partition disagrees with Watcom's real frame layout. Confirm the intended slot in the .asm, then pass a real contiguous CQuaternion4f local (often just `&local_2d8` itself).
Ghidra mistranslated a Watcom float bit-pattern compare as `(int)x`. Hex 0x3e19999a is the IEEE 754 bit pattern of 0.15f. Rewrite in a .keep as a plain float compare against 0.15f.
